title: Dashboard Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema for bloqr-dashboard's own configuration file (.jsonc). Persists user settings and named profiles (collections of settings + references to compiler-config files). See issue #267 for the full design.

version.description: Dashboard config schema version, for migration/compatibility checks

settings.description: Global default settings, used when no profile is active or as fallback values for a profile that doesn't override them

defaultRulesDirectory.description: Default directory compiled output is copied to when --copy-to-rules is used

backup.description: Backup/restore settings for both this Dashboard config and any compiler configs it references

backupDirectory.description: Path to store backup copies of config files, relative to the Dashboard config's own directory unless absolute

activeProfile.description: Name of the currently active profile (must match a key in `profiles`), or null if none active

adGuardApi.description: Placeholder settings for the future adguard-api-dotnet integration (#272). Disabled by default; not a functioning client.

baseUrl.description: AdGuard DNS API base URL to use once a client is wired in

apiKeyEnvironmentVariable.description: Name of the environment variable an API key/token will be read from. Never store the credential itself here.

profiles.description: Named profiles — collections of settings overrides plus references to one or more compiler-config files. Keyed by profile name.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this profile is for

settingsOverrides.description: Per-profile overrides of the global `settings` object; unspecified fields fall back to the global defaults

compilerConfigs.description: Paths to one or more compiler-config files (see compiler-config.schema.json) that make up this profile
